description: Defines function prototypes and data structures related to 'delta islands' and 'islands' within a version control or repository system. It provides interfaces for comparing object IDs, checking if objects are in the same island, resolving tree islands, loading delta islands, propagating island marks, computing pack layers, and freeing island mark resources.

methods.name: island_delta_cmp
methods.description: Compares two object IDs to determine their delta island order or similarity.

methods.name: in_same_island
methods.description: Checks if two object IDs belong to the same delta island.

methods.name: resolve_tree_islands
methods.description: Resolves and identifies islands within the repository's tree structure.

methods.name: load_delta_islands
methods.description: Loads delta island information into the repository context.

methods.name: propagate_island_marks
methods.description: Propagates island markings through the commit graph within the repository.

methods.name: compute_pack_layers
methods.description: Computes layering information for packing objects based on islands.

methods.name: free_island_marks
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for island markings.
